added.spacr.qt.screens.regression.HitsOpener.p:
The Hits button: build the results panel in steps, then open.

The first press used to build the screen's whole results panel in
one go, a freeze of over a second. It is now built one step per
event-loop turn (see ``AppScreen._build_owed_part_in_steps``) and
the tab is raised when it is finished. With the panel built, or on
a screen that defers nothing, this is :meth:`open`.

spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScr.before:
Open a folded module on this screen, pointed at the open field.

The module arrives as a PAGE beside the editor, which is where a
fold belongs; it becomes a window only if this screen has no body
to make pages out of.

:param key: one of :data:`FOLD_ORDER`.
:returns: the module's panel, or ``None`` for a key this screen does
    not fold. Pressing the same button again raises the page that is
    already there rather than building a second one.
spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScr.after:
Open a folded module on this screen, pointed at the open field.

The module arrives as a PAGE beside the editor, which is where a
fold belongs; it becomes a window only if this screen has no body
to make pages out of.

THE FIRST FOLD MAKES THE PAGE STRIP IN A TURN OF ITS OWN. Making it
moves this screen's whole body onto the strip, and Qt restyles every
widget of a body it moves; that and the page joining the strip were
one freeze. A breath between them lets the window answer.

:param key: one of :data:`FOLD_ORDER`.
:returns: the module's panel, or ``None`` for a key this screen does
    not fold. Pressing the same button again raises the page that is
    already there rather than building a second one.
